lab13-02.narration: With the starting conditions prepared, let us follow the recorded run. Begin with Local habitat and ask about L-417 work records. The answer refers to the seeded work order and technician note. Inspect the provenance label: simulated work knowledge. This is a real model invocation over synthetic training evidence. The Energy Hub remains the operational authority. A useful explanation of a work order is not a command receipt, and it does not clear the override.
